description: `activity inbox` with no --peek, run outside any dispatched-task context (no MULTIVERSE_TASK_ID — this harness's curated base env never sets it unless a step adds it, so cwd-at-project-root already reads as orchestrator), advances the recipient's own activity.cursor (cli.py: will_acknowledge gates on is_orchestrator, written only via activity.acknowledge once read_inbox returns). A second call with nothing new prints the one generic 'nothing new' line — there is no separate wording for a repeated empty call.

expect.stdout:
[<TIMESTAMP>] sandbox: hello there
current through event 1 as of <TIMESTAMP>
last read at <TIMESTAMP>, through event 1

nothing new for sandbox2.
current through event 1 as of <TIMESTAMP>
last read at <TIMESTAMP>, through event 1
